subject: Marine Works - Halifax Harbour and Approaches
text:
Marine Works - Halifax Harbour and Approaches
Reef installation underway in Halifax Harbour. Reef ball clusters will be installed in the following positions:
44 35.800N, 063 31.400W,
44 35.817N, 063 31.383W,
44 35.800N, 063 31.367W.
Operations will include two work vessels, one barge and divers. The area will be marked with marker buoys and styrofoam floats within 150 foot radius of 44 35.800N, 063 31.382W.
